summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon with obfuscated WebSocket command channel and PTY/shell sinks
details: The package ships a long-running daemon (invoked via the `whalent` CLI) that connects outbound to a WebSocket gateway (wss://) operated by the publisher and accepts remote commands from that gateway, including 'upgrade' and 'restart' operations. The bundle depends on node-pty and @xterm/headless (full terminal/PTY), ws, ssh2, and socks-proxy-agent, and dist/core.cjs contains many WebSocket message-handling sites feeding into child_process spawn/execFile call sites — a network-sourced command channel into shell/PTY sinks on the installer host. Both shipped bundles (dist/index.cjs ~112 KB and dist/core.cjs ~13.6 MB) are processed with javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotation of length 1118 and 105426 respectively, control-flow flattening, hex-mangled identifiers such as _0x1e6a99/_0x278106), so the exact set of gateway-directed operations reachable on the host is not inspectable from the published artifact. The daemon-plus-gateway architecture is disclosed in the README, but the combination of PTY/shell execution driven by a remote party and aggressive obfuscation of the command dispatch surface leaves the installer's host under the operational control of whoever controls the wss:// gateway.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
